newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 28.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Association of Southeast Asian nations (ASEAN) urged to promote democracy in Burma, peace in Cambodia.
-- Japan's anti-monopoly watchdog Fair Trade Commission to screen mergers of non-Japanese companies.
-- ASEAN Regional Forum expresses concern over Burma situation.
-- ASEAN Regional Forum backs ASEAN mediation in Cambodia.
--Japan rejects United States' plea, to reopen aid to Cambodia.
